explanation: Copy the successor's payload into the target and link the target directly to the successor's successor.
correctness: Every path before the target is unchanged. Replacing the target value and bypassing its successor removes exactly the target position from the value sequence while preserving the required target identity.
walkthrough: The list is 9 -> 4 -> 7 -> 2 and the supplied target is the node currently holding 4. Copy 7 into that same target object and point it to the node holding 2. The head-to-tail values become [9,7,2]. An alias to the target now observes 7, while an alias to the bypassed successor still refers to its separate, unchanged object.
